snippet.title: Late Shift - Demo Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Matt is a London car park attendant who gets pulled into a high-stakes heist he wants no part of. This live-action FMV thriller lets you choose what he does at every turn, and those choices lead to several very different endings.
